abstract.t: This document specifies publickey-kem, a Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM)-based user authentication method for the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol. The server encapsulates a fresh shared secret to an authorized client public key. The client demonstrates possession of the corresponding private key by returning a session-bound confirmation value. The method does not modify SSH transport or server host authentication. Initial authentication algorithm profiles using ML-KEM and HMAC-SHA256 are also specified.
